clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for dimensions and tolerances, construction, finish, tests and marking of following accessories, made of vitreous china : Half round channel, Foot rest, Traps for squatting pans, Floor traps, and Shower rose.

clauses.title: Construction – The accessories
clauses.text: 2. Construction - The accessories shall be of one piece construction. Note — In case of floor trap (see Fig. 4), the grating  (jali) is a separate piece.

clauses.title: Finish – All the
clauses.text: 3. Finish - All the functional surfaces of the accessories, that is, those coming in contact with water shall be glazed uniform and smooth, in order to ensure an efficient function and use

clauses.title: Performance Test – Applicable
clauses.text: 4.1. Performance Test -  Applicable only for shower rose (see Fig. 5). The shower rose when fitted at a height of 2100 mm from the floor under a minimum of 3 m head shall wet a circular area having 450 mm as its minimum diameter on the floor.

clauses.title: Flushing Test – Applicable
clauses.text: 4.2 Flushing Test - Applicable only for traps for squatting pans (see Fig. 3). the flushing test shall be performed in accordance to the provisions stipulated in IS : 2556 (Part 3) : 1994+.
